item.title: Democratic Party Expects "Practical Appointment, Role in Prosecution Reform" from Han Chan-sik as Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs (與, 한찬식 민정수석 임명에 “실용적 인사, 검찰개혁 역할 기대”)
item.description:
Democratic Party Expects "Practical Appointment, Role in Prosecution Reform" from Han Chan-sik as Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs (與, 한찬식 민정수석 임명에 “실용적 인사, 검찰개혁 역할 기대”)

On the 22nd, the Democratic Party of Korea commented on the appointment of former prosecutor-turned-lawyer Han Chan-sik as the new Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs at the presidential office, stating, "He is regarded within the prosecution as a rational and practical figure," and added, "He is recognized as the right person for prosecution reform, as he understands the culture of the prosecution organization better than anyone." (더불어민주당은 22일 청와대 신임 민정수석비서관으로 검찰 출신인 한찬식 변호사가 임명된 것에 대해 “검찰 내에서도 합리적이고 실용적인 인사로 평가받은 인물”이라며 “검찰 조직의 문화를 누구보다 잘 알고 있어 검찰개혁의 적임자로 인정받았다”고 했다.)

In a briefing under the name of Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon, the Democratic Party said, "Regarding the prosecution reform, which is drawing public attention, the role of Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik is highly anticipated." (민주당은 이날 강준현 수석대변인 명의 브리핑에서 “세간의 관심이 쏠리고 있는 검찰개혁에 대해서도 한찬식 민정수석의 역할이 기대된다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang described Han as "a figure far removed from the outdated practices and harmful remnants of Yoon Seok-youl's political prosecution, which is tainted by manipulation," and noted, "He expressed his intention to resign from his position as a senior prosecutor just before Yoon Seok-youl's inauguration as Prosecutor General in 2019, and even after resigning, he stated his convictions on the prosecution reform desired by the public." (강 수석대변인은 한 수석에 대해 “조작으로 얼룩진 윤석열 정치검찰의 구태 및 잘못된 잔재와는 거리가 먼 인물”이라며 “2019년 윤석열 당시 검찰총장의 취임을 앞둔 시점에 검사장직에서 사의를 표명했고, 사직을 하면서도 국민이 바라는 검찰개혁에 대해 소신을 밝힌 바 있다”고 했다.)

When President Lee appointed Han as the new Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs the day before, some within the ruling party's support base voiced opposition. They raised issues with Han's background as a former prosecutor who led the investigation into the so-called 'Ministry of Environment blacklist' targeting the previous Moon Jae-in government, and his status as the son-in-law of the late Choi Byung-ryeol, former leader of the Grand National Party. The Fatherland Innovation Party also expressed concern, and some individuals voiced dissent. In response, the Democratic Party stepped forward to defend Han's appointment. (이 대통령이 전날 한 변호사를 신임 민정수석으로 임명하자 여권 지지층 일각에선 반발이 터져 나왔다. 이들은 한 수석이 문재인 정부 때 정권을 겨냥한 ‘환경부 블랙리스트’ 수사를 지휘한 검사 출신이라는 점, 고(故) 최병렬 전 한나라당 대표의 사위라는 점 등을 문제 삼았다. 조국혁신당도 우려를 표했고, 일부 인사들은 반대 의사를 표명했다. 그러자 민주당에서 나서서 한 수석 임명을 방어하고 나선 것이다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, "Beyond the separation of the Public Prosecution Service and the Senior Civil Service Corruption Investigations Office, we must now effectively design their respective authorities and functions while completing a system subject to democratic checks," and added, "Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik, who has accumulated a balanced record of strict law enforcement and human rights sensitivity, is the right person to faithfully carry this out." He further said, "We will fully support the start of the second-term presidential office staff and strongly back the government's state affairs management." (강 수석대변인은 “공소청과 중수청 분리를 넘어 이제는 각각의 권한과 기능을 효과적으로 설계함과 동시에 민주적 견제를 받는 체제로 완성해야 한다”며 “법 집행의 엄정성과 인권 감수성을 균형있게 축적해 온 한찬식 민정수석은 이를 착실하게 수행할 적임자”라고 했다. 그러면서 “청와대 2기 참모진의 출발을 전폭적으로 지원하며, 정부의 국정운영을 강력하게 뒷받침하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim: "After Returning to the National Assembly, Discuss 'One-point Constitutional Amendment' for Election Commission Reform" (김 총리 “국회 복귀 후 선관위 개혁 ‘원포인트 개헌’ 논의”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim: "After Returning to the National Assembly, Discuss 'One-point Constitutional Amendment' for Election Commission Reform" (김 총리 “국회 복귀 후 선관위 개혁 ‘원포인트 개헌’ 논의”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 22nd regarding the shortage of local election ballots, "We will ensure that the National Assembly engages in full-fledged discussions on a one-point constitutional amendment related to the reform of the National Election Commission." He added, "For this issue, which the majority of the public feels is problematic, I will strive for the ruling and opposition parties to reach an agreement and create an alternative that society can accept, even through a one-point constitutional amendment." Prime Minister Kim is reportedly expected to formalize his declaration to run for the leadership of the Democratic Party around the end of this month, when the appointment process for candidate Prime Minister Han Sung-sook concludes. <<> On this day, Prime Minister Kim held a meeting with the press corps at the Government Seoul Office and said, "After stepping down as prime minister and returning to the National Assembly, I plan to focus on two things." He noted, "I believe our society and political circles have relatively lacked communication with young people and university students. Therefore, regarding the issue of suffrage, I intend to support youth-led social discourse." <<> He continued, "In addressing the issue of civic suffrage, I will make efforts in a way where the youth take the lead and the government supports from behind." He added, "Taking this suffrage issue as an opportunity, I have long pursued a platform where young people can directly step up and discuss youth issues. During today's regular briefing, I will also make a special proposal to the President regarding this, and I will actively push for this issue upon returning to the National Assembly and the party." <<> Regarding the decline in President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for state affairs after the June 3 local elections, Prime Minister Kim stated, "This is a time when the party must make efforts to support the President's administration and boost the overall approval ratings of the party and government." He added, "I believe the role of working more broadly and deeply has grown larger." Prime Minister Kim said, "Looking back at the past period, various opinion polls have shown that the President led the approval ratings for state affairs with a leadership that was almost hard to surpass, and that was a key factor." He added, "Until now, the structure has been one where the President's leadership drove the approval ratings for state affairs, and those ratings in turn pulled up the party's approval ratings." <<> He continued, "After the elections, both the approval ratings for state affairs and the party's are showing a downward trend." He added, "The election results might be pulling down the overall approval ratings of the party and government, or the party's approval ratings could be heavily declining and dragging down the state affairs approval ratings." <<> Prime Minister Kim said, "Now that the elections are over, I believe the party needs two things. One is perfect unity and cooperation between the party and government." He added, "Once I return to the party, I am increasingly feeling a sense of responsibility to do my utmost to restore the party's approval ratings in that direction, leading to a recovery in state affairs approval ratings, and further strengthening the momentum of governance." <<> Regarding his one-year term, Prime Minister Kim said, "As of July 3, my official term as prime minister will reach one year." He added, "The Office for Government Policy Coordination seems to have summarized the message, but it's a bit embarrassing to say it myself—it was a year of handling assigned tasks perfectly without any controversy." <<> He continued, "I think I managed to settle the tasks I was given to a certain extent without major controversy." He added, "Looking back, whether it was party affairs, government affairs, or elections, I feel that when given a task, I handled it without major mistakes or failures, and I consider myself fortunate." (김민석 국무총리는 22일 지방선거 용지 부족 사태와 관련해 “중앙선거관리위원회 개혁과 관련된 원포인트 개헌을 국회에서 본격적으로 논의하도록 하겠다”며 “국민 대다수가 문제의식을 느끼고 계신 이 문제만큼은 여와 야가 합의해서 개헌을 원포인트 개헌을 통해서라도 사회가 인정할 수 있는 대안을 만들어낼 수 있도록 노력하겠다”고 했다. 김 총리는 한성숙 총리 후보자의 임명 절차가 끝나는 이달 말쯤 민주당 당 대표 출마 선언을 공식화할 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Park Ji-young, Former Special Counsel, Tapped as Presidential Secretary for Judicial Affairs ([단독] 靑 사법제도비서관에 특검 출신 박지영 내정)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Park Ji-young, Former Special Counsel, Tapped as Presidential Secretary for Judicial Affairs ([단독] 靑 사법제도비서관에 특검 출신 박지영 내정)

Park Ji-young (56), a former prosecutor-turned-lawyer, has reportedly been nominated as the presidential secretary for judicial affairs under the Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs, it was learned on the 22nd. Following the appointment of Han Chan-sik as senior presidential secretary for civil affairs, another former prosecutor has been selected for the secretary for judicial affairs, who handles tasks related to "prosecution reform" within the civil affairs office. Lawyer Park had also joined as a deputy special counsel in the "insurrection special counsel" investigation into former President Yoon Suk-yeol and others regarding the December 3 martial law incident. <<> A key source in the ruling camp said on the same day, "Lawyer Park has been nominated as the secretary for judicial affairs and is expected to report to the presidential office soon. After the abolition of the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, as the Public Prosecution Office and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office open, she will handle follow-up tasks for prosecution reform, such as the issue of prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority and the referral of all cases." <<> Lawyer Park graduated from the Judicial Research and Training Institute (29th class) and began her career as a prosecutor at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office in 2000, leaving the prosecution in 2023 after serving as the head of the appeals division at the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office. During her tenure, she held positions including head of the general affairs department and head of the criminal affairs division 6 at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office, team leader of the prosecution reform task force at the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, deputy chief of the Daejeon District Prosecutors' Office, and deputy chief of the Chuncheon District Prosecutors' Office. Notably, as a rank-and-file prosecutor, she served in the Ministry of Justice's prosecution affairs division, which handles personnel and budgets. She was also the first female prosecutor to work in that division. After leaving the prosecution, she worked as a lawyer at law firm Pacific before joining the "insurrection special counsel" as a deputy special counsel, where she also handled media relations. <<> The position of presidential secretary for judicial affairs under the Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs was newly established under the Lee Jae-myung administration to reform the criminal justice system, including courts and prosecutors. After the government's launch, Lee Jin-guk, a professor at Ajou University Law School, was appointed as the first secretary for judicial affairs but resigned after just eight months, leaving the post vacant for nearly four months. Following Han Chan-sik's appointment as senior secretary for civil affairs and Park's nomination, predictions have emerged that the prosecution reform work will accelerate. However, there have also been reactions within the ruling camp saying, "Since both are former prosecutors, there are concerns about whether the prosecution reform will be properly carried out." (청와대 민정수석실 사법제도비서관에 검사 출신 박지영(56) 변호사가 내정된 것으로 22일 알려졌다. 한찬식 청와대 민정수석비서관에 이어 민정수석실에서 실제 ‘검찰 개혁’ 관련 업무를 담당하는 사법제도비서관에도 검찰 출신이 발탁되는 것이다. 박 변호사는 12·3 비상계엄 사태와 관련해 윤석열 전 대통령 등을 수사한 ‘내란 특검’에도 특검보로 합류했었다.)

item.title: Korea-Ukraine Foreign Ministers' Meeting on the 30th... "Promptly Expedite Transfer of North Korean Prisoners to South Korea" (30일 한·우크라 외교장관 회담... “북한군 포로 한국행 신속 추진”)
item.description:
Korea-Ukraine Foreign Ministers' Meeting on the 30th... "Promptly Expedite Transfer of North Korean Prisoners to South Korea" (30일 한·우크라 외교장관 회담... “북한군 포로 한국행 신속 추진”)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul announced at a press briefing on the 22nd that he will hold talks with Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha, who is scheduled to visit South Korea, in Seoul on the 30th. The foreign ministerial meeting is expected to include discussions on the repatriation of two North Korean soldiers captured by Ukrainian forces after being deployed to fight alongside Russian troops. (조현 외교부 장관은 22일 기자간담회에서 방한 예정인 안드리 시비하 우크라이나 외교장관과 오는 30일 서울에서 회담을 개최한다고 밝혔다. 이번 외교장관 회담에선 러시아군에 파병됐다가 우크라이나에 생포된 북한군 포로 2명의 송환 문제에 대한 논의가 이뤄질 예정이다.)

A senior Foreign Ministry official told reporters on the same day regarding the two North Korean prisoners: "We are pushing for their transfer to South Korea as quickly as possible, in accordance with their free will." (외교부 고위 당국자는 이날 기자들과 만나 북한군 포로 2명과 관련해 “가급적 신속하게 (포로들의) 자유의사에 따라 한국행을 추진하려고 하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

"A basic agreement has already been reached with the Ukrainian side," the official said. "That principle remains unchanged, and with the Ukrainian foreign minister's visit this time, I expect there may be some progress." (그는 “우크라이나 측과 이미 기본적 합의는 다 이뤄져 있다”며 “그 원칙은 변함이 없고 이번에 (우크라이나) 외교장관이 방한하면 또 약간의 진전이 있을 수 있지 않을까 그렇게 기대하고 있다”고 말했다.)

When asked whether the meeting between Minister Cho and Minister Sybiha could result in an announcement regarding the North Korean prisoners' transfer to South Korea, the senior official replied, "It is difficult for me to say," but added, "We are working on it." (고위 당국자는 조 장관과 시비하 장관과의 회담을 통해 ‘북한군 포로의 한국행을 발표할 수 있느냐’는 질문에는 “제가 얘기하기 곤란하다”면서도 “노력하고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding South Korea-U.S. nuclear energy cooperation, the senior official stated, "Consultations took place in South Korea last time, and they will likely occur in the United States soon," adding, "We expect all of this to be concluded within the year." (외교부 고위 당국자는 한미 원자력 협력과 관련해 “지난번에 협의가 한국에서 있었고, 머지않아 미국에서도 있을 것”이라며 “연내에 이런 모든 것이 타결될 수 있을 것으로 기대한다”고 밝혔다.)

On February 2-3, South Korea and the U.S. held discussions in Seoul on implementing security cooperation agreed upon by the two countries' leaders during their summit last October, including the construction of a nuclear-powered submarine for South Korea and securing rights for uranium enrichment and spent nuclear fuel reprocessing. (한미 양국은 지난 2∼3일 서울에서 한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함(원잠) 건조, 우라늄 농축 및 사용후핵연료 재처리 권한 확보 등 한미 정상이 작년 10월 정상회담에서 합의한 안보 분야 협력 이행 문제를 논의했다.)

For South Korea to obtain enrichment and reprocessing rights, options being considered include a full or partial revision of the existing South Korea-U.S. nuclear agreement, or securing such authority through a separate arrangement. (한국이 농축·재처리 권한을 가지려면 기존 한미 원자력 협정 전면 혹은 일부 개정이나 별도 약정을 통한 권한 확보 등 방안이 거론된다.)

The senior official said, "There could be an amendment to the nuclear cooperation agreement, or we could utilize existing provisions by adding an addendum—there are various approaches. We will decide after reviewing the agreed-upon content." (고위 당국자는 “원자력 협력 협정의 개정이 있을 수 있고 거기에 기존에 있는 것을 활용해서 부록(addendum)을 붙이는 방안도 있고 여러 가지가 있다”며 “합의하는 내용을 봐가면서 결정하려고 한다”고 했다.)

"The content is far more important than the format, and the same goes for nuclear-powered submarines," the official added. "However, our clear goal is to reach an agreement swiftly." (이어 “형식보다는 내용이 훨씬 중요하고 핵잠(원잠)도 마찬가지”라며 “그러나 신속하게 합의를 끌어내고자 하는 게 분명히 목표”라고 했다.)

On the issue of Coupang, which has been affecting South Korea-U.S. relations, the senior official said, "There has been a certain level of consensus reached between the authorities of the two governments," adding, "The diplomatic authorities of both South Korea and the U.S. will work to resolve such issues well, ensuring that the problem of these companies violating local laws does not excessively escalate or recur." (고위 당국자는 한미 관계에 영향을 미치고 있는 쿠팡 문제에 대해선 “한미 정부 당국 간에는 어느 정도 의견 일치가 이뤄졌다”면서 “한미 양국 외교 당국 간에는 이런 문제를 잘 해결해서 이런 기업의 실정법 위반 문제가 과도하게 확대, 재생산되지 않도록 잘 관리해나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the restrictions on intelligence sharing between South Korea and the U.S. on North Korea, triggered by Unification Minister Kim Yung-ho's remarks about "North Korea's nuclear facilities," the senior official said, "Both the U.S. and us are likely to find a way out. I believe that will happen." (외교부 고위 당국자는 정동영 통일부 장관의 ‘북한 구성 핵시설’ 발언이 촉발한 한미 간 대북 정보 공유 제한에 대해서는 “미국 측도 그렇고 우리도 그렇고 여기에 대한 출구를 찾지 않겠는가. 그렇게 될 것으로 믿는다”고 했다.)

On the situation where China did not publicly mention the North Korean nuclear issue during the recent North Korea-China summit in Pyongyang, leading to speculation that Beijing is tacitly condoning Pyongyang's nuclear program, the senior official said, "China avoids mentioning it as needed. Evading the issue, as you know, is linked to a combination of factors, including China's relations with North Korea and Russia's relations with North Korea." (고위 당국자는 최근 평양에서 열린 북중 정상회담에서 북핵 문제를 공개적으로 거론하지 않아 중국의 ‘북핵 묵인설’이 나오는 상황에 대해 “(중국은) 필요에 따라 언급을 피하는 것”이라며 “언급을 회피하는 것은 잘 아시다시피 중국과 북한과의 관계, 또 러시아와 북한 간의 관계 이런 것들과 종합적으로 작용하고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding whether Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi will visit South Korea, the official said, "I understand it will happen soon," adding, "We will discuss ways to further smooth and elevate South Korea-China relations." (왕이 중국 외교부장의 방한 여부에 대해서는 “머지않아 있을 것으로 알고 있다”면서 “한중관계를 더 원활하게 하고 격상시킬 방안을 협의해보겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, Minister Cho stated that the government has "proactively prepared" for South Korean companies to participate in reconstruction projects in the Middle East following a potential U.S.-Iran agreement to end the war. (한편, 조 장관은 이날 정부가 미국과 이란의 종전 합의 이후 한국 기업이 중동 지역 재건 사업에 참여할 수 있도록 “선제적으로 대비해왔다”고 밝혔다.)

Minister Cho said, "To facilitate our companies' participation in post-war recovery efforts in the Middle East and to devise comprehensive economic cooperation plans with the region, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has established a Korea-Middle East Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Team. Through overseas missions, we have actively identified tailored cooperation needs with various Middle Eastern countries." (조 장관은 “전후 우리 기업의 대중동 피해 복구 참여와 중동과의 포괄적이고 종합적인 경제협력 방안을 마련하기 위해 외교부 내에 한-중동 포괄적 경제협력팀을 설치하고 재외공관을 통해 중동 각국과 맞춤형 협력 수요를 적극 발굴해왔다”고 했다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim Reflects on First Year: "Handled My Tasks Without Controversy" (金총리, 총리 1년 “맡은 일은 잡음 없이 해냈다” 자평)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Reflects on First Year: "Handled My Tasks Without Controversy" (金총리, 총리 1년 “맡은 일은 잡음 없이 해냈다” 자평)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok evaluated his performance over the past year in office, stating, "There were relatively many events, and I managed to organize my tasks to some extent without significant controversy." (김민석 국무총리가 지난 1년간의 총리직 수행에 대해 “비교적 많은 일이 있었고, 비교적 큰 잡음 없이 맡은 일은 어느 정도 정리해 냈다”고 자평했다.)

Ahead of his first anniversary as Prime Minister on the 4th of next month, Kim held a press briefing at the Government Seoul Complex on the 22nd and remarked, "In my political career, whether handling party affairs, government matters, or elections, I believe I have managed to complete the tasks entrusted to me without major mistakes or failures, and I consider that fortunate." (다음 달 4일로 총리 취임 1년을 맞는 김 총리는 22일 정부서울청사에서 기자 간담회를 하고 “제 정치 생활에서 당의 일이건 정부의 일이건 선거이건 어떤 일을 맡으면 맡은 일은 큰 실수나 실패 없이 처리해 낸 것 같다는 생각이 들어서 다행”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

In a press release distributed before the briefing, the Prime Minister's Office highlighted 12 achievements under Kim’s leadership: "Successful hosting of the APEC Summit," "Securing the Global AI Hub," "Creating breakthroughs in social conflicts," "Pioneering practical diplomacy as Prime Minister," "Addressing the fallout from the insurrection," "Communicating state affairs with the public," "Driving locally-led growth," "Leading youth cooperation," "Reducing the number of suicide deaths," "Expanding cross-governmental agendas," "Resolving pressing issues as a field-oriented, people-focused Prime Minister," and "Responding to the economic emergency from the Middle East war." (총리실은 이날 간담회에 앞서 배포한 보도 자료를 통해 김 총리의 업무 성과로 ‘APEC(아시아태평양경제협력체) 정상회의 성공 개최’ ‘글로벌AI허브 유치’ ‘사회적 갈등 돌파구 마련’ ‘총리 실용 외교 개척’ ‘내란 청산’ ‘대국민 국정 소통’ ‘지방 주도 성장 견인’ ‘청년 협치 선도’ ‘자살 사망자 수 감소 주도’ ‘범정부 어젠다 확장’ ‘현장·민생 총리로 현안 해결 주도’ ‘중동 전쟁 비상 경제 안정 대응’ 등 12가지를 들었다.)

Kim said, "The matter I was most worried and focused on was hosting the APEC summit," adding, "I essentially 'went all in' on APEC for the first few months." He continued, "Thanks to the President's exceptional leadership, successfully pulling off the APEC summit without major issues was a great personal accomplishment," and noted, "The success of APEC served as a signal to the international community that South Korea had returned to normalcy after the insurrection." (김 총리는 “가장 걱정하고 신경 쓴 일은 APEC 정상회의 개최였다”며 “초반 몇 달을 거의 APEC에 ‘올인’했다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “대통령님의 탁월한 리더십에 힘입어서 APEC(정상회의)를 큰 문제 없이 성공시킨 것이 저로서는 큰 보람”이라며 “APEC 성공은 내란 이후 대한민국을 국제사회에 정상 복귀시키는 신호탄이 됐다”고 했다.)

Kim then cited as his second achievement the proposal to the United Nations to consolidate AI-related functions from various UN bodies, specialized agencies, and partner organizations into a single hub, fostering collaboration, and securing South Korea as the host country for this "Global AI Hub." He explained, "I visited the U.S. and Switzerland to meet with heads of international organizations, including the UN Secretary-General, and even brought in multilateral development banks, convincing hesitant organizations to join," and predicted, "Securing the Global AI Hub will be seen as a decisive milestone on South Korea's path to becoming one of the top three AI powerhouses in 20 to 30 years." (김 총리는 이어서 유엔의 여러 산하 기구와 전문 기구, 협력 기구에 있는 AI(인공지능) 관련 기능을 한곳에 모아 서로 협력하게 하고, 이 ‘글로벌AI허브’를 한국에 두자는 구상을 유엔에 제안해 한국 유치를 확정한 것을 두 번째 성과로 꼽았다. 김 총리는 “미국과 스위스를 방문해 유엔 사무총장을 비롯한 국제 기구의 장들을 만나고 다자 개발 은행들까지 참여시켜서, 합류를 주저하던 기구들이 합류를 결정하게 했다”며 “글로벌AI허브 유치는 20~30년 뒤에는 대한민국이 AI 3강으로 가는 길에서 결정적인 성과로 평가될 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim also noted, "Several experiences in creating breakthroughs in social conflicts have left me with a great sense of fulfillment," elaborating, "I met with farming groups protesting outside the presidential office, leading to the end of their sit-in, and regarding the medical conflict, I invited medical students, resident doctors, and representatives of medical associations, resulting in announcements of their intent to return." Regarding a recent meeting with university student representatives to discuss the issue of the National Election Commission infringing on citizens' voting rights, he assessed, "I contributed to helping these young students view the situation as a flawed process and shift their focus toward seeking alternatives leading to NEC reform rather than calling for a full re-election." (김 총리는 또 “사회적 갈등의 돌파구를 마련한 몇 가지 경험이 매우 큰 보람으로 남아 있다”며 “대통령실 앞에서 농성 중이던 농민 단체와 면담해 농성을 해제하게 했고, 의정 갈등과 관련해 의대생, 전공의, 의사 단체 대표들을 초청해 의대생·전공의의 복귀 의사 발표로 이어졌다”고 했다. 최근 대학생 대표들을 만나 선거관리위원회의 국민 참정권 침해 문제에 관해 논의한 것을 두고는 “대학생 청년들이 이번 사태를 부실 사태로 보고, 전면적인 재선거보다는 선관위 개혁에 이르는 대안의 모색으로 방향을 잡게 되는 데 일정한 기여를 했다”고 자평했다.)

On conducting diplomatic activities separately from the President, Kim stated, "There has long been a notion in our society that 'the Prime Minister handles domestic affairs and the President handles diplomacy,' but from the start, I believed that 'the Prime Minister oversees state affairs under the President's direction, and those affairs are not divided into domestic and foreign categories.'" He added, "I have consistently worked under the belief that the Prime Minister has a role in diplomacy, which was previously considered outside the Prime Minister's purview." He further noted, "I visited the U.S. twice to meet with President Trump and Vice President Vance, and each time we discussed issues centered on the Korean Peninsula." (김 총리는 대통령과 별도로 외교 활동을 한 것에 대해서는 “그동안 우리 사회에는 ‘내정은 총리가 하고 외교는 대통령이 한다’는 이야기가 있었는데, 저는 처음부터 ‘총리는 대통령의 명을 받들어 국정을 통할하고, 그 국정은 내정과 외교로 구분되지 않는다’고 생각했다”며 “종래에는 총리 영역이 아닌 것으로 생각돼 왔던 외교에도 총리의 역할이 있다고 생각해 꾸준히 노력해 왔다”고 했다. 그러면서 “미국을 두 번 방문해 트럼프 대통령, 밴스 부통령을 뵙고 그때마다 한반도 문제를 중심으로 논의를 했다”고 소개했다.)

Kim also assessed that he had taken the lead within the administration in what he termed "addressing the insurrection." He said, "While remaining firm in principle and strict in handling matters, I minimized controversy as much as possible, concluding the process with minimal disruption to the civil service within the executive branch." (김 총리는 자기가 행정부 내에서 이른바 ‘내란 청산’을 주도했다고도 자평했다. 그는 “원칙은 단호하게, 일처리는 엄격하게 하면서도 최대한 잡음이 없게 해서, 행정부 공직 사회의 동요를 최소화하면서 일처리를 마감했다”고 했다.)

He continued, "I strove to communicate state affairs with the public to the best of my ability," adding, "Under the name 'K-State Briefings,' I toured the country explaining government achievements." He also noted, "Taking responsibility under the Prime Minister's Office for implementing locally-led growth has been meaningful, and I have also devoted significant attention and effort to youth issues." (이어 “최선을 다해 국민과 국정 소통을 하고자 했다”며 “‘K-국정 설명회’라는 이름으로 전국을 돌면서 국정 성과를 설명했다”고 소개했다. 또 “지방 주도 성장의 실행을 총리실 책임하에 맡은 것도 의미 있게 생각하고 있고, 청년 문제도 제일 큰 관심을 갖고 노력했다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Kim mentioned, "The number of suicides, which averaged over 1,000 per month, has dropped to the 900s for several months now," and expressed hope, "I wish for religious leaders and the public to cooperate in resolving the suicide issue." Kim also counted as achievements the establishment of a public-private joint task force to overhaul drone and anti-drone policies, and the shift of ODA policy direction toward AI and culture. (김 총리는 한편 “월평균 1000명이 넘던 자살자 숫자가 900명대로 떨어진 지가 몇 개월째”라며 “우리 사회 종교인들과 국민 여러분이 협력해서 자살 문제를 해소해 나갔으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 김 총리는 드론·대드론 정책을 정비하기 위해 민관 합동 TF를 만든 것, ODA(공적개발원조) 정책 방향을 AI와 문화 중심으로 바꾼 것도 성과로 꼽았다.)

Kim further stated, "I did my best to respond on the ground," and claimed, "Whether it was a wildfire or the fire at the National Information Resources Service, I believe there has never been a single article saying the Prime Minister's visit was late." He added, "The Prime Minister's Office actively responded to the voice phishing issue, significantly reducing the damage, and when the Middle East war created an economic emergency, I served as head of the emergency economic command as Prime Minister, ensuring that various government departments functioned smoothly and responded stably during the emergency period." (김 총리는 이어 “최선을 다해서 현장에서 대응하고자 노력했다”며 “산불이 나건 국가정보자원관리원 화재 사건이 나건, 적어도 총리 방문이 늦었다는 기사는 한 번도 난 적이 없었던 것 같다”고 했다. 또 “보이스피싱 문제도 총리실이 적극적으로 대응해서 피해를 상당히 감소시켰고, 중동 전쟁으로 비상 경제 상황이 발생했을 때 총리로서 비상경제본부장이 돼서 정부 각 부서가 잘 돌아갈 수 있도록 노력해서 비상 경제 기간에 안정적으로 대응했다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Only Korea National Railway Actively Cooperated with Martial Law"... Government Announces Results of Full Investigation into Public Institutions (“국가철도공단만 계엄 적극 협조”... 정부, 공공기관 전수조사 결과 발표)
item.description:
"Only Korea National Railway Actively Cooperated with Martial Law"... Government Announces Results of Full Investigation into Public Institutions (“국가철도공단만 계엄 적극 협조”... 정부, 공공기관 전수조사 결과 발표)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination announced on the 22nd that, after a full investigation into whether any public institutions cooperated with the December 3 martial law, no institution other than the Korea National Railway was found to have done so. (국무조정실이 12·3 계엄에 협조한 공공기관이 있는지를 전수 조사한 결과, 국가철도공단 외에는 협조한 기관이 확인되지 않았다고 22일 밝혔다.)

Earlier on December 6 last year, MBC reported that the Korea National Railway had transmitted the martial law commander's proclamation to its branches from 1:03 AM to 2:21 AM on December 4, 2024—after the National Assembly passed a motion to lift the martial law at 1:00 AM—and instructed them to closely cooperate with the military and police under their jurisdiction. In response, Prime Minister Kim ordered the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Office for Government Policy Coordination the next day to "check whether similar cases occurred in other public institutions." (앞서 지난달 6일 MBC는 국가철도공단이 국회에서 계엄 해제 요구안이 가결된 2024년 12월 4일 오전 1시보다 뒤인 오전 1시 3분부터 2시 21분까지 지사에 계엄사령관 포고령을 전달하면서 관할 군경과 긴밀히 협조하라고 지시했다고 보도했다. 그러자 김 총리는 이튿날 국토교통부와 국무조정실에 “다른 공공기관에도 유사한 사례가 있었는지 점검하라”고 지시했다.)

Regarding this, the "Constitutional Respect Government Innovation TF (Task Force)" of the Office for Government Policy Coordination released a press statement on the afternoon of the 22nd, stating, "We conducted a full inspection of 340 public institutions under 49 central administrative agencies regarding their participation in or cooperation with the illegal declaration of martial law on December 3." (이와 관련해 국조실 ‘헌법 존중 정부 혁신 TF(태스크포스)’는 22일 오후 보도 자료를 배포해 “49개 중앙행정기관 산하 340개 공공기관을 대상으로 12·3 불법 계엄 선포 당시 계엄 관련 참여·협조에 대한 전수 점검을 실시했다”고 밝혔다.)

It continued, "As a result of an audit by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport on the Korea National Railway, it was confirmed that immediately after the illegal declaration of martial law, following the former chairman's instructions, the corporation specified the proclamation and measures required by affiliation and disseminated them to all employees, and activated an active response system related to martial law, including forming an initial response team." It added, "Accordingly, we are pursuing follow-up measures such as requesting investigations and disciplinary actions against those involved." (이어 “국가철도공단에 대해 국토부가 감사를 진행한 결과, 공단은 불법 계엄 선포 직후 전 이사장 지시에 따라 포고령 및 소속별 조치 필요 사항을 구체화해 전 직원에게 전파했고, 초기 대응반을 편성하는 등 계엄 관련 적극적 대응 체계를 가동한 사실이 확인됐다”고 전했다. 그러면서 “이에 따라 관련자들에 대한 수사 의뢰 및 징계 등 후속 조치를 추진한다”고 했다.)

The TF stated, "No active measures like those of the Korea National Railway were found in other institutions." (TF는 “다른 기관에서는 국가철도공단과 같은 적극적 조치가 발견되지 않았다”고 했다.)

The TF further explained, "Korea Midland Power retrospectively drafted an 'Emergency Response Action Plan upon Declaration of Martial Law' on December 10, 2024, but no intention to cooperate with the illegal martial law was confirmed." However, it also noted, "Nevertheless, in drafting the action plan, a violation of security work regulations was identified." (TF는 이어 “한국중부발전은 ‘계엄령 선포 시 비상 대응 조치 계획’을 2024년 12월 10일 사후적으로 작성했으나, 불법 계엄에 협조하려는 의도는 확인되지 않았다”고 했다. 그러면서도 “다만 조치 계획을 작성하면서 보안 업무 규정을 위반한 사실을 확인했다”고 밝혔다.)

The TF also stated, "47 institutions took measures such as internally sharing the fact of the martial law's declaration or revocation, or related reports and proclamation content, urging normal work performance and management of attendance and service, maintaining public service discipline, and placing executives on standby via phone." It added, "The remaining institutions took no separate measures." (TF는 또 “47개 기관은 계엄 선포·해제 사실 또는 관련 보도·포고령 내용의 내부 공유, 정상 업무 수행과 근태·복무 관리 및 공직 기강 유지 당부, 간부 유선 대기 등을 시행했다”고 밝혔다. “나머지 기관들은 별도의 조치가 없었다”고 했다.)

item.title: Chung Se-hyun Compares Lee Administration's North Korea Policy to Michael Jackson's Moonwalk: "Civil Society Must Hold Advisors Accountable" (정세현, 李정부 대북정책 “마이클 잭슨의 문 워크같아...시민사회가 참모들 문책해야”)
item.description:
Chung Se-hyun Compares Lee Administration's North Korea Policy to Michael Jackson's Moonwalk: "Civil Society Must Hold Advisors Accountable" (정세현, 李정부 대북정책 “마이클 잭슨의 문 워크같아...시민사회가 참모들 문책해야”)

Former Unification Minister Chung Se-hyun said on the 22nd regarding the recent Korea-EU joint statement's inclusion that North Korea cannot be recognized as a nuclear state, "The Yoon Suk Yeol administration's stance is being blindly followed by the Lee Jae-myung administration's security office," adding, "Because of these (security office) advisors, we can't even find a needle's eye to advance inter-Korean relations." <<> At the '2026 International Forum on the Korean Peninsula' held at the Banking Hall in Jung-gu, Seoul, former Minister Chung stated, "(The president) is trying to thread the needle for inter-Korean relations, but they've poured concrete on it," and "We can't continue with people like this." He further said, "Civil society must hold these advisors accountable," emphasizing, "Civil society leaders need to reprimand the president's diplomatic and security advisors." <<> Former Minister Chung noted, "Since the current administration took office, measures like suspending leaflet distribution, halting loudspeaker broadcasts, and offering an apology over drones have created some room to thread the needle," but "This time, the president went to Brussels, fell for his advisors' tricks, and ended up reading a script that led to the unfortunate situation of returning to a state of 'perpetual enemy'." North Korea had previously reacted to the Korea-EU joint statement through a statement titled "South Korea is an unchanging enemy state ingrained with hostility and confrontation" issued in the name of a spokesperson from the Foreign Ministry's 10th Bureau, claiming that "the South Korean ruler has thrown off the mask of peace that was hindering him." <<> On this day, former Minister Chung likened the Lee Jae-myung administration's approach to North Korea policy to Michael Jackson's moonwalk. "The president talked about improving inter-Korean relations during his first-anniversary press conference," he said. "It's like Michael Jackson's moonwalk. He appears to step forward but ends up moving backward." He added, "Why does South Korea have to interfere with the EU's criticism of North Korea-Russia military cooperation? It could have been done through separate press statements instead of a joint one. And why mention the Taiwan issue there? That's also a step backward," continuing, "(The president) tries to move forward, but his advisors pull him back. We need to stop this." <<> The Korea-EU joint statement includes content such as "condemning Russia's war of aggression against Ukraine," "condemning in the strongest possible terms the expansion of illegal military cooperation between Russia and North Korea," and "North Korea will never be recognized as a nuclear state under the NPT." It also contains "the importance of maintaining peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait" and "opposition to unilateral attempts to change the status quo in the Indo-Pacific region." <<> Former National Intelligence Service Director Suh Hoon said at the forum regarding inter-Korean relations, "I think it's right to take a long-term view and consider this a time to pause," adding, "I believe it could be a period of preparation and transition." Former Director Suh noted, "The current inter-Korean relations are quite disappointing and painful," and "This is an unprecedented period in our past relations." He added, "Even in the past, there was no situation like this. Defining and examining the current state of inter-Korean relations in this way might allow for more accurate observation and better strategic direction." <<> Former Director Suh stated, "North Korea's talk of 'hostile two-state' relations or whatever—those claims aren't all necessarily filled in," and "I think both North Korea and we now need to prepare for what comes next." He concluded, "The past can serve as a reference, but it can't be the answer. Charting a new path is the right course for inter-Korean relations." (정세현 전 통일부 장관은 22일 최근 한·EU공동성명에 북한을 핵보유국으로 인정할 수 없다는 내용이 포함된 데 대해 “윤석열 정부 때의 입장을 이재명 정부의 안보실이 그대로 답습하고 있다”며 “(안보실) 참모들 때문에 (남북 관계의) 바늘구멍을 뚫을 수 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Jung Cheong-rae Approves Promotions and Transfers for Party Staff Right Before Resignation... Some within Party Call It "Inappropriate" ([단독] 정청래, 사퇴 직전 당직자 승진·전보 인사... 당내 일각 “부적절”)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Jung Cheong-rae Approves Promotions and Transfers for Party Staff Right Before Resignation... Some within Party Call It "Inappropriate" ([단독] 정청래, 사퇴 직전 당직자 승진·전보 인사... 당내 일각 “부적절” )

The Democratic Party of Korea conducted promotions and transfers for its staff on the 22nd. Within the ruling party, questions arose, such as, "Is it appropriate for acting leader Jung Cheong-rae, who is set to resign this week to run for another term as party leader, to approve personnel changes for party staff?" (더불어민주당이 22일 당직자 승진·전보 인사를 냈다. 여권에선 “당대표 연임 도전을 위해 이번 주 사퇴를 앞둔 정청래 대표가 당직자 인사를 내는 것이 맞느냐”는 말이 나왔다.)

According to political sources, the Democratic Party issued personnel changes for party staff under the name of Secretary General Cho Seung-rae on the same day. It was reported that dozens of individuals were affected by the promotions and transfers in this round of personnel moves. (정치권에 따르면, 민주당은 이날 조승래 사무총장 명의로 당직자 인사를 냈다. 이번 인사로 승진·전보 대상자 수십 명이 인사 이동을 한 것으로 전해졌다.)

Inside and outside the Democratic Party, criticism emerged that "it is inappropriate for the Jung Cheong-rae leadership, which is on the verge of leaving office, to approve personnel changes for party staff." Acting leader Jung is known to be planning to resign around the 24th to run in the Democratic Party's national convention, where the next party leader will be elected. (민주당 안팎에선 “퇴임을 코 앞에 둔 정청래 지도부가 당직자 인사를 내는 것은 부적절하다”는 비판이 나왔다. 정 대표는 차기 당대표를 뽑는 민주당 전당대회 출마를 위해 오는 24일 전후 사퇴할 것으로 알려졌다.)

In response, a Democratic Party secretariat official stated, "The labor union and the collective agreement stipulated that 'regular personnel changes are conducted according to regulations (regardless of the national convention),' so the personnel changes were carried out as scheduled," adding, "This is unrelated to the party leadership race." According to the Democratic Party's internal rules, regular personnel changes are conducted annually in May. However, in last year's by-election for party leader, major position appointments were made only after Jung Cheong-rae was elected as party leader. (이에 대해 민주당 사무처 관계자는 “노조와 단체협약에서 ‘정기 인사는 (전당대회와 관련 없이) 규정대로 한다’고 합의해서 인사를 예정대로 낸 것”이라면서 “당권 투쟁과는 관련 없다”고 했다. 민주당 당규에는 정기 인사를 매년 5월에 실시한다고 돼 있다. 다만 지난해 당대표 보궐선거에서도 주요 보직 인사는 정청래 대표가 당대표에 선출된 이후에 이뤄졌다.)

Inside and outside the Democratic Party, it is known that there is a high likelihood that acting leader Jung will also replace some district party chairs before stepping down from the party leadership. A Democratic Party insider commented, "It is inappropriate for a party leader, who is just one or two days away from resigning, to 'hold onto' district party chairs as well." In response, a secretariat official said, "The district party chairs need to be reorganized first before provincial party chairs can be elected and the national convention can be held," adding, "This is not an unusual personnel move." (민주당 안팎에선 정 대표가 당대표직을 내려놓기 전 일부 지역위원장도 미리 교체할 가능성이 큰 것으로 알려졌다. 한 민주당 관계자는 “사퇴가 하루이틀 남은 당 대표가 지역위원장까지 ‘알박기’하는 것은 부적절하다”고 했다. 이에 대해 사무처 관계자는 “지역위원장을 먼저 개편해야 이후에 시도당위원장을 선출하고, 전당대회도 치를 수 있다”면서 “이례적인 인사는 아니다”라고 했다.)

item.title: Defense Ministry and UNC at Odds Over ‘North Korean Violation of Armistice’ (국방부·유엔사, 이번엔 ‘北 정전협정 위반’ 놓고 엇박자)
item.description:
Defense Ministry and UNC at Odds Over ‘North Korean Violation of Armistice’ (국방부·유엔사, 이번엔 ‘北 정전협정 위반’ 놓고 엇박자)

South Korea's military authorities and the United Nations Command have taken opposing stances regarding the North Korean military's construction of barbed-wire fences along the Military Demarcation Line (MDL). Since the new government took office last year, differences between the South Korean military and the UNC over jurisdiction of the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) have surfaced, and analysts say this discord is now evident in their responses to North Korea. (우리 군 당국과 유엔군사령부가 북한군의 군사분계선(MDL) 일대 철책 설치 공사와 관련해 상반된 입장을 내놓았다. 지난해 정부 출범 이후 비무장지대(DMZ) 관할권 등을 두고 노출된 군과 유엔사의 이견이 대북 대응에서도 드러났다는 분석이 나온다.)

Defense Ministry spokesperson Jeong Bit-na stated on the 22nd, “The North Korean military’s installation of obstacles along the MDL is a clear violation of the Armistice Agreement,” adding, “Our military will continue to respond in close cooperation with the UNC.” This referred to the North Korean military’s recent construction of barbed-wire fences at a point 80–100 meters north of the MDL, asserting it was a breach of the armistice. While North Korea has been conducting such construction since 2024, when Chairman Kim Jong-un defined inter-Korean relations as “hostile two states,” this is the first time the South Korean military has publicly declared it a “violation” of the Armistice Agreement. (정빛나 국방부 대변인은 22일 “북한군의 MDL 일대 장애물 설치는 명백한 정전협정 위반”이라며 “우리 군은 유엔사와 긴밀한 협력을 통해서 지속해서 대응해 나갈 것”이라고 밝혔다. 북한군이 최근 MDL 북측 80~100m 지점에서 철책 공사를 했고, 이는 정전 협정 위반이란 취지였다. 북한군은 김정은 국무위원장이 남북을 ‘적대적 두 국가’로 규정한 2024년부터 줄곧 이런 공사를 해왔지만, 우리 군이 정전협정 ‘위반’이라는 입장을 밝힌 것은 처음이다.)

However, the United Nations Command, which determines violations of the Armistice Agreement, responded to an inquiry from this outlet on the same day by stating, “Construction, fortification, and other defensive measures do not automatically constitute a violation of the Armistice Agreement.” The UNC noted that while the Armistice Agreement stipulates a DMZ extending 2 km north and south of the MDL, some sections of South Korea’s barbed-wire fences already lie within the DMZ, and some fences are very close to the MDL. Therefore, it is reportedly difficult to single out only the North’s construction—conducted with prior notification—as a problem. <<> It is reported that the South Korean government recently raised an objection in talks with the UNC, questioning whether the North Korean military’s transformation of the MDL into a border line constitutes a “violation of the Armistice Agreement,” to which the UNC responded that it does not. Nevertheless, when the Defense Ministry briefed that it was an “Armistice Agreement violation” without further consultation with the UNC, sources inside and outside the military suggested that this could be an attempt to undermine the armistice system managed by the UNC. <<> In November of last year, the Defense Ministry announced that it had “conveyed intentions for talks to the North via the UNC” to discuss the delineation of the MDL, but the UNC stated it had never conveyed such a stance to the North. Regarding the DMZ jurisdiction held by the UNC commander under the Armistice Agreement, the Defense Ministry argued last month at the Korea-U.S. Integrated Defense Dialogue that “significant progress had been made” in separating certain areas for the South Korean military to oversee. However, the UNC reiterated its existing position that “jurisdiction lies with the UNC commander.” (하지만 정전협정 위반 여부를 판단하는 유엔군사령부는 이날 본지 질의에 “건설, 요새화 및 여타 방어적 조치가 자동적으로 정전협정 위반에 해당하지는 않는다”고 했다. 유엔사는 정전협정상 MDL 남북 2㎞의 DMZ를 두기로 했지만, 이미 한국 철책 일부 구간이 DMZ 내에 있고 MDL에 매우 근접한 철책도 있어 북한이 사전에 통보하고 진행한 공사만 문제 삼기는 어렵다는 입장으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: National Assembly's ‘NEC Hearing’: 7 Out of 9 Election Commissioners Refuse to Appear (국회 ‘선관위 청문회’ 정작 선관위원들은 9명 중 7명 불출석)
item.description:
National Assembly's ‘NEC Hearing’: 7 Out of 9 Election Commissioners Refuse to Appear (국회 ‘선관위 청문회’ 정작 선관위원들은 9명 중 7명 불출석)

It has been reported that a large number of Central Election Commission members, who were summoned as witnesses for the National Assembly's parliamentary investigation into the shortage of ballot papers for the June 3 local elections, are refusing to appear. All Songpa District Election Commission members, who are at the center of the controversy, have notified their absence. (23일 열리는 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명을 위한 국회 국정조사에 증인으로 채택된 중앙선거관리위원들이 대거 불출석 하는 것으로 전해졌다. 논란의 중심이 된 송파구 선관위원들은 전원이 불출석을 통보했다.)

On the 22nd, the ruling and opposition parties agreed to select 43 individuals as witnesses for the plenary session of the Special Committee on the Parliamentary Investigation, including 27 Central Election Commission officials (including 9 commissioners), 6 Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission officials, and 10 Songpa District Election Commission officials. However, it has emerged that only two of the nine commissioners selected as witnesses have indicated their intention to attend: former Central Election Commission Chairperson Noh Tae-ak and acting Central Election Commission Chairperson Wi Cheol-hwan. The remaining seven commissioners—Jo Byung-hyun, Jo Sung-dae, Park Soon-young, Nam Rae-jin, Kim Dae-woong, Yoon Gwang-il, and Jeon Hyun-jung—have notified their absence. This means that all non-standing commissioners except former Chairperson Noh are not appearing. (여야는 22일 국조특위 전체회의에 출석할 증인으로 중앙선거관리위원 9명을 포함한 중앙선관위 관계자 27명과 서울시 선관위 6명, 송파구 선관위 10명 등 43명을 채택하는 데 합의했다. 그러나 증인으로 채택된 선관위원 9명 가운데 출석 의사를 밝힌 인사는 노태악 전 중앙선관위원장과 위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행 등 2명인 것으로 나타났다. 조병현·조성대·박순영·남래진·김대웅·윤광일·전현정 위원 등 나머지 7명은 불출석을 통보했다. 노 전 위원장을 뺀 비상임 선관위원이 나오지 않는 것이다.)

Most of the witnesses who have agreed to attend are senior operational staff, including Acting Secretary-General Kang Dong-wan, Inspector Lim Jeong-soo, Acting Director of the Election Policy Office Ok Mi-seon, Acting Director of the Election Bureau 1 Jo Bong-gi, and Head of the Election Management Division Yoon Yo-seop. The Special Committee plans to focus its questioning on the ballot shortage incident in Songpa District during the plenary session on the 23rd, but only two operational staff from the Songpa District Election Commission will attend, while all commissioners, including former Chairperson Min So-young, have notified their absence. (출석하기로 한 증인들 대다수는 강동완 사무총장 직무대리와 임정수 감사관, 옥미선 선거정책실장 직무대리, 조봉기 선거1국장 직무대리, 윤요섭 선거관리과장 등 실무 책임자들이다. 국조특위는 23일 전체회의에서 송파구 투표용지 부족사태를 집중 추궁할 계획인데, 정작 송파구 선관위에선 실무진 2명만 참석하기로 하고 민소영 전 위원장을 비롯한 선관위원 전원이 불출석을 통보했다.)

Meanwhile, the Central Election Commission issued a statement late that evening, stating that it "takes seriously" the results of the investigation into the ballot shortage incident. Following a commission meeting, the NEC said, "The policies proposed by the fact-finding committee will be reviewed alongside measures to improve the election management system, which will be discussed in the upcoming parliamentary investigation," and added, "We will make utmost efforts to ensure fundamental systemic improvements are made so that an incident undermining citizens' right to vote does not recur." This came three days after the fact-finding committee on the ballot shortage wrapped up its activities on the 19th, pointing out overall issues in election management. The fact-finding committee also recommended requesting an investigation into senior NEC officials, including former Chairperson Noh Tae-ak and former Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hoon, but the NEC did not state its position on this matter that day. (한편, 중앙선거관리위원회는 이날 밤 투표지 부족 사태와 관련한 진상조사 결과를 “무겁게 받아들인다”는 입장을 내놨다. 선관위는 위원회 회의 결과 “진상규명위가 제언한 정책 등은 향후 국정조사에서 논의될 선거관리시스템 개선 방안 등과 함께 검토하겠다”며 “국민 참정권을 훼손하는 사태가 재발하지 않도록, 근본적 제도개선이 이뤄질 수 있도록 최대한 노력할 예정”이라고 했다. 투표지 부족 사태 진상규명위원회가 지난 19일 활동을 마무리하며 선거관리 전반의 문제를 지적한 지 사흘 만이다. 진상규명위는 노태악 전 위원장, 허철훈 전 사무총장 등 중앙선관위 간부들에 대한 수사 의뢰도 권고했는데, 선관위는 이날 이에 대한 입장은 밝히지 않았다.)

item.title: The Growing Distance Between the People Power Party's Top Two (점점 멀어지는 국민의힘 투톱)
item.description:
The Growing Distance Between the People Power Party's Top Two (점점 멀어지는 국민의힘 투톱)

People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik on the 22nd assessed the June 3 local elections, stating, “I believe the public has laid the groundwork for the opposition to rise again while simultaneously demanding profound reflection and reform.” This contrasts with the perception of party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who has touted a ‘strong performance’ narrative in the local elections, emphasizing the party’s rising approval ratings. (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표가 22일 6·3 지방선거에 대해 평가하며 “국민들이 야당이 다시 일어설 수 있는 토대를 마련해주시는 동시에 뼈저린 성찰과 쇄신을 주문하신 것으로 본다”고 했다. 장동혁 대표가 지방선거 ‘선방론’을 내세우며 당 지지율 상승을 강조하고 있는 상황 인식과는 견해차를 보인 것이다.)

During the party's Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly in Seoul that morning, Floor Leader Jeong said, “We must humbly accept the public sentiment revealed in the local elections, address our shortcomings, and prepare for victory in the general election two years from now.” (정 원내대표는 이날 오전 서울 국회에서 열린 당 최고위원회의에서 “지선으로 나타난 민심을 겸허히 받들며 부족한 지점을 채워나가 2년 뒤 총선 승리를 준비해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the party’s increasing approval ratings since the local elections, he drew a line, saying, “This increase is not because we performed well,” and added, “It is a command for reform to boldly innovate into a healthy and capable conservative party.” He continued, “Now is the time for us to move forward into the future with humility once again,” and warned, “If we don’t change, we cannot survive.” (그는 지선 이후 상승하고 있는 당 지지율에 대해서도 “우리가 잘해서 오른 것이 아니다”라고 선을 그으며 “건강하고 유능한 보수 정당으로 과감하게 혁신하라는 쇄신의 명령”이라고 했다. 이어 “이제 우리는 다시 겸허한 자세로 미래로 나아가야 할 시간”라며 “변화하지 않으면 생존할 수 없다”고 했다.)

Floor Leader Jeong’s remarks that day were interpreted as a direct rebuttal of the claims made by leader Jang Dong-hyuk and his faction holding party power. Amidst growing calls within the party for Jang to resign, taking responsibility for the local election defeat, Jang dismissed the resignation theory on his Facebook page on the 11th, saying, “Even a golden cross in party approval ratings is useless. I’m not even looking at the poll results showing that the People Power Party performed better in these local elections.” His aides have defended him, arguing, “The party achieved better-than-expected results in these local elections, and approval ratings are rising, so why should the leader resign?” (정 원내대표의 이날 발언은 장동혁 대표와 당권파들의 주장을 정면으로 반박한 것으로 해석됐다. 장 대표는 지방선거 패배의 책임을 지고 사퇴하라는 당내 요구가 잇따르자 지난 11일 자신의 페이스북에 “당 지지율 골든크로스도 소용없다. 국민의힘이 (이번 지방선거에서) 더 선전했다는 여론조사 결과는 쳐다보지도 않는다”며 사퇴론을 일축했다. 장 대표 측은 “사실상 이번 지방선거에서 국민의힘이 기대 이상의 성과를 냈고 당 지지율도 오르고 있는데 왜 대표가 사퇴해야 하느냐”고 옹호해 왔다.)

Floor Leader Jeong also expressed regret once again over the party’s release of a press statement the previous day, which claimed that “Leader Jang gave his all to ensure the victory of candidates in the June 3 local elections.” After the Supreme Council meeting went into a closed session, Floor Leader Jeong reportedly voiced disappointment over the distribution of a self-congratulatory evaluation of the local elections in the party’s name without prior discussion. The previous day, the party had stated, “Compared to the 2018 local elections, the number of elected officials increased by 2 metropolitan mayors and governors, 42 basic local government heads, 191 metropolitan council members, and 268 basic council members.” <<> Meanwhile, Leader Jang, who has been hospitalized since the 18th due to overwork, was again unable to attend the Supreme Council meeting that day. Party leader’s chief of staff Park Jun-tae held a briefing at the National Assembly that afternoon and reported, “Essentially, Leader Jang’s physical strength has significantly deteriorated.” Regarding reports of a review into a party leadership reshuffle, he stated, “There has been no practical review.” Lawmaker Kim Eun-hye, who had been mentioned as a candidate for a party position, indicated her refusal on her Facebook page that day, saying, “Even if an offer comes, I will focus all my energy on this fight (against the National Election Commission) and this mission commanded by the people.” (정 원내대표는 전날 당이 “6·3 지방선거에서 장 대표가 후보자들 당선을 위해 혼신을 다했다”는 내용의 보도자료를 낸 것에 대해서도 재차 유감을 표했다. 최고위가 비공개로 전환된 뒤 정 원내대표는 사전 논의 없이 당 명의로 자화자찬의 지방선거 평가 자료가 배포된 데 대한 아쉬움을 언급했다고 한다. 전날 당은 “2018년 지방선거와 비교해 당선인 수는 광역단체장 2명, 기초단체장 42명, 광역의원 191명, 기초의원 268명 각각 증가했다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Indirectly Criticizes Jeong Cheong-rae… "Party Approval Ratings May Be Dragging Down Government Approval Ratings" (김민석, 정청래 우회 비판… “당 지지율이 국정 지지율 끌어내린 것일 수도”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Indirectly Criticizes Jeong Cheong-rae… "Party Approval Ratings May Be Dragging Down Government Approval Ratings" (김민석, 정청래 우회 비판… “당 지지율이 국정 지지율 끌어내린 것일 수도”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok held his final press briefing on the 22nd ahead of running in the August Democratic Party leadership election. Regarding the concurrent decline in approval ratings for the president and the ruling party, Kim stated, "It could be that the local election results are dragging them down, or it could be that the party approval ratings are dragging down the government approval ratings," targeting party leadership contender Jeong Cheong-rae. (김민석 국무총리가 8월 민주당 당대표 선거 출마를 앞두고 22일 마지막 기자간담회를 열었다. 김 총리는 대통령과 여당 지지율 동반 하락과 관련해 “지방선거 결과가 끌어내리는 것일 수도 있고, 당 지지율이 국정 지지율을 끌어내리는 것일 수도 있다”며 당권 경쟁자인 정청래 대표를 겨냥했다.)

At the press briefing held at the Government Complex Seoul, Kim said, "The government and ruling party approval ratings, which were previously driven by the president, are both declining." He added, "President Lee has led the government approval ratings with a leadership that is hard to surpass. Yet, after the elections, both the government and party approval ratings have dropped." He continued, "When I return to the party soon, I feel a growing sense of responsibility to work hard to restore party approval ratings and strengthen the government's momentum." Kim recently stated, "It is difficult to declare this local election a complete victory," attributing the failure to retake the Seoul mayoral position to the leadership of Jeong Cheong-rae. On this day, Kim also referenced the split of the Open Our Party, saying, "Division is absolutely unacceptable." <<> Regarding the issue of supplementary investigative powers for the prosecution, where the president and Jeong Cheong-rae have differing stances, Kim said, "Abolishing it is unavoidable at this point." While President Lee holds the position that "minimal exceptions should be allowed," Jeong has argued for "complete abolition" as demanded by hardline supporters—aligning Kim with Jeong's stance. A Democratic Party official noted, "With the party leadership election approaching, he has no choice but to cater to the tastes of the party base." However, Kim added, "I fully understand the president's perspective," suggesting that further discussion should include the president's view that the matter requires deliberation. <<> Kim departed for Beijing, China, on this day to attend the annual meeting of the World Economic Forum (Summer Davos Forum), an international event held from the 23rd to the 25th. Kim plans to declare his candidacy for party leadership later this month, or by early next month at the latest, once the appointment process for his successor as prime minister is finalized. (김 총리는 이날 정부서울청사에서 간담회를 열고 “대통령이 견인하던 국정과 여당 지지율이 동반 하강하고 있다”며 이같이 말했다. 그러면서 “이 대통령은 더 잘하기 어려울 정도의 리더십으로 국정 지지율을 이끌었다”며 “그런데 선거 이후 국정·당 지지율이 다 하강한 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “제가 곧 당으로 돌아가면 당 지지율을 회복하고, 그것이 국정 동력을 강화하도록 전력을 다해야겠다는 책임감을 점점 강하게 느끼고 있다”고 했다. 김 총리는 최근 “이번 지방선거는 완벽한 승리로 선언하기는 어렵다”며 서울시장 탈환 등의 실패 책임을 정청래 지도부에 돌리기도 했다. 김 총리는 이날도 열린우리당의 분당 사태를 언급하며 “분열은 절대 있어선 안 될 일”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee's Approval Rating Drops as Negative Assessments Rise... Impact of Myung-Chung Conflict and Asset Polarization (부정 평가가 더 높아진 李… 명청 갈등·자산 양극화 영향)
item.description:
Lee's Approval Rating Drops as Negative Assessments Rise... Impact of Myung-Chung Conflict and Asset Polarization (부정 평가가 더 높아진 李… 명청 갈등·자산 양극화 영향)

Another poll has emerged showing a 'dead cross' for President Lee Jae-myung, where positive evaluations of his state affairs performance have fallen below negative ones. Just over a year into his term, experts attribute the decline in Lee's approval rating to factors such as the departure of some support base due to the Myung-Chung conflict within the ruling party, the shift in moderate public sentiment triggered by the controversy over the dismissal of charges in Lee's case, and the sense of deprivation among young people caused by worsening asset disparities in real estate and stocks. The presidential office stated it would humbly accept public sentiment. (이재명 대통령의 국정 수행에 대한 긍정 평가가 부정 평가 아래로 떨어지는 ‘데드 크로스(Dead Cross)’ 여론조사 결과가 또 나왔다. 취임 1년을 갓 지난 이 대통령의 지지율 하락세에 대해 전문가들은 여권 내 명·청 갈등으로 인한 일부 지지층 이탈, 이 대통령 사건 공소취소 논란으로 인한 중도층 민심 이반, 부동산·주식 등 자산 격차 심화로 인한 청년층의 박탈감 등을 원인으로 꼽았다. 청와대는 민심을 겸허히 수용하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다.)

According to a survey conducted by polling agency Realmeter from the 15th to the 19th on 2,517 people aged 18 and older nationwide, released on the 22nd, 46.7% positively evaluated President Lee's state affairs, while 49.7% gave negative assessments. Although the gap is within the margin of error (±2 percentage points), it marks the first time in 12 months since his inauguration that negative evaluations have surpassed positive ones. Positive evaluations of state affairs have declined for five consecutive weeks after reaching 60.5% in the second week of May. By region, it fell by over 10 percentage points in the Seoul metropolitan area; by political inclination, among moderates; and by generation, among those in their 20s and 30s. (여론조사 업체 리얼미터가 지난 15~19일 18세 이상 전국 2517명을 대상으로 실시해 22일 발표한 조사에 따르면, 이 대통령 국정 수행을 긍정적으로 평가한 사람은 46.7%, 부정적으로 평가한 사람은 49.7%였다. 격차가 오차범위(±2%포인트) 이내지만 취임 12개월 만에 부정 평가가 긍정 평가를 앞지른 셈이다. 국정 수행 긍정 평가는 5월 둘째 주 60.5%를 기록한 후 5주 연속 하락했다. 지역별로는 수도권에서, 정치 성향별로는 중도층, 세대별로는 20·30대에서 10%p 이상 하락했다.)

In an earlier survey by Jo Won C&A conducted from the 13th to the 15th, President Lee's negative evaluations (49%) also outpaced positive ones (47.6%). By Realmeter's standards, former President Park Geun-hye saw negative evaluations surpass positive ones 15 months after her inauguration, former President Moon Jae-in after 19 months, and former President Yoon Suk-yeol just six weeks after taking office. (앞서 조원씨앤아이가 지난 13~15일 실시한 조사에서도 이 대통령의 국정 수행에 대한 부정 평가(49%)가 긍정 평가(47.6%)를 앞질렀다. 리얼미터 조사 기준으로, 박근혜 전 대통령은 취임 후 15개월, 문재인 전 대통령은 취임 후 19개월, 윤석열 전 대통령은 취임 후 6주 만에 처음으로 부정 평가가 긍정 평가를 앞질렀다.)

Yoon Tae-gon, director of the Deomore Political Analysis Office, stated, "It's not so much that people think the President can't do the job, but rather that he's distracted by matters other than people's livelihoods." Yoon added, "The President's focus seems to be on the dismissal of charges in his own case and taking the lead in the party convention, and this attitude is affecting even moderate voters." Within the ruling party, concerns are rising as competition heats up ahead of the Democratic Party's convention in August, with some noting, "It's only the second year of his term." Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Gwang-jae wrote on his Facebook that day, "I express deep concern over the division and conflict unfolding ahead of the party convention." (윤태곤 더모아 정치분석실장은 “이 대통령이 ‘일을 못 한다’고 생각해서라기보다, ‘민생이 아닌 딴곳에 정신이 팔려 있다’고 보는 것”이라고 했다. 윤 실장은 “이 대통령의 관심사가 본인 사건에 대한 공소취소, 전당대회 주도권에 치중된 것으로 보이는데, 이런 태도가 중도층에도 영향을 주고 있다”고 했다. 여권 내에서도 8월 민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 여권 내 경쟁이 과열되자 “이제 겨우 집권 2년 차”라며 우려가 나오고 있다. 민주당 이광재 의원은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “전당대회를 앞두고 벌어지는 분열과 갈등에 큰 우려를 표한다”고 했다.)

Bae Jong-chan, director of Insight K Research Institute, cited asset market polarization as a reason for the approval rating decline. "Large-cap stocks like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are mostly held by middle-aged and older individuals, while young people tend to own more small-cap stocks. The recent market rally, centered on large caps, is instilling a sense of deprivation among the youth," Bae said. Senior Presidential Secretary Kang Hoon-sik, while chairing a meeting of senior secretaries and aides that day, emphasized, "We will invest excess tax revenue intensively in projects for future generations," a remark interpreted as mindful of the recent decline in approval among those in their 20s and 30s. (배종찬 인사이트케이 연구소장은 자산 시장 양극화를 지지율 하락 이유로 꼽았다. 배 소장은 “삼성전자나 SK하이닉스 같은 대형주는 중장년 보유 비율이 높고, 청년층은 상대적으로 소형주를 많이 가지고 있는데 대형주 위주로 상승하는 최근 장세는 청년층에게 박탈감을 안기고 있다”고 했다. 강훈식 대통령비서실장은 이날 청와대 수석·보좌관 회의를 주재하면서 “초과세수를 미래 세대를 위한 사업에 집중적으로 투자하겠다”고 강조했는데 최근 20·30대 지지율 하락을 염두에 둔 발언이라는 해석이 나왔다.)

Some also pointed to changes in survey respondents as a factor. Park Sung-min, CEO of political consulting firm Min, explained, "Ahead of the local elections, the ruling party's overwhelming lead caused conservative voters to avoid polls, but they're actively responding now after the elections." He added, "As discussions among the opposition shift to focus on Oh Se-hoon and Han Dong-hoon, the approval rating of the People Power Party is rising while that of the President and the ruling party is falling." (여론조사 응답자의 변화를 이유로 꼽기도 했다. 박성민 정치컨설팅 민 대표는 “지방선거 전 여권의 압도적 우세 분위기 때문에 보수층 유권자가 여론조사를 피하는 경향이 강했으나, 지방선거 이후엔 적극 응하고 있다”고 했다. 이어 “야권 논의의 중심이 오세훈·한동훈 중심으로 이동하면서 국민의힘 지지율 상승과 대통령·여당의 지지율 하락으로 나타나고 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee has attempted to reverse the approval rating decline through two press conferences and a reshuffle of his presidential office staff after the local elections, but without success. Notably, Lee has stressed that he has no intention of changing his state affairs direction in response to the local election results and the declining approval rating. During a press conference marking his first anniversary in office on the 8th, just after the elections, he said, "I might have thought about it too simply. It's not that I didn't think, 'I've worked so hard, I haven't done anything wrong, and at least I won't throw anything away.'" Yet he also stated regarding the policy direction, "Nothing will change." At a press conference on the 19th related to his European tour, he also said, "State affairs haven't changed. The biggest thing is, 'People are struggling to make a living, so what are we fighting over?'" indicating his view that intense internal party strife was the cause of the approval rating decline. (이 대통령은 지방선거 이후 두 차례 기자회견과 청와대 참모진 개편을 통해 지지율 반등을 꾀했지만 여의치 않은 상황이다. 특히 그동안 이 대통령은 지방선거 결과와 지지율 하락세와 관련해서 국정 기조를 바꿀 생각이 없음을 강조해왔다. 선거 직후인 지난 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에선 “사실 너무 쉽게 생각한 측면도 있다. ‘이렇게 열심히 했고 내가 나쁜 짓 한 것도 아니고 최소한 뭐 버리기야 하겠어’라는 마음이 없었던 건 아니다”라고 했다. 그러면서도 국정 기조와 관련해 “바뀔 게 없다”고 했다. 지난 19일 유럽 순방 관련 기자회견 때도 “국정은 변한 것이 없다. 제일 큰 건 ‘먹고살기 힘들어 죽겠는데 뭘 가지고 싸우냐’는 거다”라며 극심한 당내 갈등이 지지율 하락의 원인이라는 입장을 밝혔다.)

However, that day the presidential office stated, "We view the recent approval rating fluctuations as a comprehensive reflection of public sentiment regarding the economic situation and evaluations of overall state management," adding, "We take this seriously and humbly, and we will pay more careful attention to what the public is worried about and hoping for." (하지만 청와대는 이날 “최근 지지율 변동은 민생 경제 상황에 대한 국민의 체감과 국정 운영 전반에 대한 평가가 종합적으로 반영된 결과로 본다”며 “이를 엄중하고 겸허하게 받아들이며 국민께서 무엇을 걱정하고 무엇을 바라고 계신지 더욱 세심하게 살피겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Following the Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs, the Secretary for Judicial System also Appoints Prosecutor-Turned Park Ji-young (靑 민정수석 이어 사법제도비서관도 검찰 출신 박지영)
item.description:
Following the Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs, the Secretary for Judicial System also Appoints Prosecutor-Turned Park Ji-young (靑 민정수석 이어 사법제도비서관도 검찰 출신 박지영)

It was confirmed on the 22nd that President Lee Jae-myung appointed Park Ji-young (56), a former prosecutor and special counsel for the "insurrection special probe," as the Secretary for Judicial System under the vacant Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs at the Cheong Wa Dae. The Secretary for Judicial System handles tasks related to the criminal justice system, including "prosecution reform." (이재명 대통령이 공석인 청와대 민정수석실 사법제도비서관에 검사 출신이자 ‘내란 특검’ 특검보를 지낸 박지영(56) 변호사를 임명한 것으로 22일 확인됐다. 사법제도비서관은 ‘검찰 개혁’ 등 형사사법제도 관련 업무를 담당한다.)

The position of Secretary for Judicial System was newly established under the Lee Jae-myung administration. While Professor Lee Jin-guk of Ajou University's Law School was appointed as the first secretary, he resigned after eight months amid conflict between the ruling party and the presidential office over the government's prosecution reform plans, leaving the post vacant for nearly four months. A source from the ruling party stated, "With Park filling the position, the follow-up work on prosecution reform is expected to gain more momentum." (사법제도비서관은 이재명 정부에서 신설된 직책이다. 초대 비서관에 이진국 아주대 법학전문대학원 교수가 임명됐지만 정부의 검찰 개혁안을 둘러싼 당청 갈등 속에 이 비서관이 8개월 만에 사퇴하며 4개월 가까이 공석이었다. 여권 관계자는 “박 변호사가 자리를 채우게 되면서 검찰 개혁 후속 작업에 더욱 속도가 붙을 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

The newly appointed Secretary Park, a graduate of the Judicial Research and Training Institute (29th class), previously served as the chief of the Yeoju branch of the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office and as a senior prosecutor at the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office. She joined the "insurrection special probe" investigating former President Yoon Suk-yeol and others regarding the December 3 martial law incident. Following President Lee's appointment of Han Chan-sik, a former chief of the Seoul Eastern District Prosecutors' Office, as the Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs the previous day, the appointment of another prosecutor to the position of Secretary for Judicial System follows. (박 신임 비서관은 사법연수원 29기 출신으로 수원지검 여주지청장, 서울고검 부장검사 등을 지냈다. 12·3 비상계엄 사태와 관련해 윤석열 전 대통령 등을 수사한 ‘내란 특검’에 특검보로 합류했다. 이 대통령이 전날 민정수석비서관에 서울동부지검장 출신 한찬식 변호사를 임명한 데 이어 사법제도비서관에도 검찰 출신을 임명한 것이다.)

A ruling party source commented, "As the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers is on an irreversible path, I understand this as an intention to minimize side effects by appointing individuals with prosecutorial backgrounds." President Lee stated at his first-anniversary press conference that he would entrust follow-up measures for "prosecution reform" to the National Assembly, aiming to block internal conflicts within the ruling party and prevent further loss of governing momentum. (여권 관계자는 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지가 거스를 수 없는 수순으로 가고 있는 만큼, 검찰 출신 인사들을 기용해 부작용을 최소화하려는 뜻으로 안다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 ‘검찰 개혁’ 후속 조치를 국회에 맡기겠다고 했는데, 여권 내 갈등을 차단하고 더 이상의 국정 동력 누수를 막겠다는 취지라는 것이다.)

Within the ruling party, the consecutive appointments of former prosecutors by the presidential office have drawn reactions like, "Another prosecutor?" In particular, regarding Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs Han Chan-sik, who oversaw the investigation of the Moon Jae-in administration's "blacklist case," Democratic Party lawmaker Ko Min-jung wrote on Facebook, "(The presidential office) should not try to control the party. It should not take the voices of party members lightly." After remaining silent on the issue the previous day, the Democratic Party issued a statement on this day through a spokesperson, saying, "Senior Secretary Han is the right person to complete the prosecution reform the public desires." The Rebuilding Korea Party, mainly composed of former Cheong Wa Dae officials from the Moon Jae-in administration, also stated, "The presidential office is turning a blind eye to the essence of reform." Rebuilding Korea Party floor leader Kim Jun-hyung expressed concerns during a meeting with Cheong Wa Dae Senior Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo on the same day. In response, Hong said, "Prosecution reform will proceed in the direction the public wants." (여권에선 청와대가 연달아 검찰 출신을 기용하자 “또 검사냐”는 반응이 나오고 있다. 특히 문재인 정부 ‘블랙리스트 사건’ 수사를 지휘했던 한찬식 민정수석에 대해, 민주당 고민정 의원은 페이스북에 “(청와대가) 당을 컨트롤하려 해선 안 된다. 당원들의 목소리를 가볍게 여겨선 안 된다”고 썼다. 민주당은 전날 아무런 논평도 내지 않다가 이날 대변인 명의로 “한 수석은 국민이 바라는 검찰 개혁을 완수할 적임자”라고 했다. 문재인 정부 청와대 출신이 주축인 조국혁신당도 “청와대가 개혁의 본질을 외면하고 있다”고 했다. 김준형 조국혁신당 원내대표는 이날 홍익표 청와대 정무수석을 만나서도 우려를 전했다. 이에 홍 수석은 “검찰개혁은 국민이 원하는 방향으로 추진될 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee Meets with Chey Tae-won Last Week, Scheduled to Meet with Lee Jae-yong on the 25th (李대통령, 지난주 최태원과 회동… 25일엔 이재용과 만날 예정)
item.description:
President Lee Meets with Chey Tae-won Last Week, Scheduled to Meet with Lee Jae-yong on the 25th (李대통령, 지난주 최태원과 회동… 25일엔 이재용과 만날 예정)

It was reported on the 22nd that President Lee Jae-myung is expected to meet with Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong around the 25th. As the government encourages companies to invest in regional areas for balanced development, there are predictions that the two will discuss specific investment plans to create youth jobs in the provinces. (이재명 대통령이 오는 25일쯤 이재용 삼성전자 회장과 만날 것으로 22일 알려졌다. 정부가 지역 균형 발전을 위해 기업의 지방 투자를 독려하는 가운데, 두 사람이 만나 지방의 청년 일자리 창출을 위한 구체적인 투자 계획을 논의할 것이라는 전망이 나온다.)

President Lee is also known to be holding a meeting on the 29th with key figures from major companies related to semiconductors and artificial intelligence (AI), including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. Industry insiders predict that large-scale regional investment plans will be announced at this gathering, with President Lee meeting Chairman Lee separately beforehand. President Lee was reported to have met with SK Chairman Chey Tae-won on the 19th. (이 대통령은 오는 29일 삼성전자, SK하이닉스 등 반도체, 인공지능(AI) 관련 주요 기업 인사들과 간담회를 가질 것으로 알려졌다. 업계에선 이 자리에서 대규모 지방 투자 계획이 발표될 것이란 예측이 나오는데, 간담회에 앞서 이 대통령이 이 회장을 따로 먼저 만난다는 것이다. 이 대통령은 지난 19일엔 최태원 SK회장을 만난 것으로 전해졌다.)

President Lee has consistently emphasized regional balanced development during his meetings with business leaders, urging corporate investment for this purpose. Accordingly, there are expectations that Samsung and SK will announce specific investment plans for the Honam region at the meeting on the 29th. This could mark another large-scale investment announcement following Hyundai Motor Group's Saemangeum investment plan earlier this year. (이 대통령은 그동안 기업 경영자들과 만날 때마다 지역 균형 발전을 강조하며 이를 위한 기업 투자를 요청해 왔다. 이에 따라, 오는 29일 간담회에서 삼성과 SK가 구체적인 호남권 투자 계획을 발표할 것이란 전망이 나온다. 올해 초 현대차그룹의 새만금 투자 계획 발표에 이어 또다시 대형 투자 계획이 발표될 수 있다는 것이다.)

In particular, the corporate regional investment plans are said to include measures for creating youth jobs. A source from the ruling party stated, "For regional balanced development, it is most important to provide quality jobs and create an environment where young people can build their lives in the provinces," adding, "Companies have been voluntarily considering various measures." The government is also expected to introduce preferential measures, such as tax benefits, for companies investing in regional areas during the meeting. (특히 기업의 지방 투자 계획엔 청년 일자리 창출 방안도 담길 것으로 전해졌다. 여권 관계자는 “지역 균형 발전을 위해선 양질의 일자리가 마련돼 청년들이 지방에서 삶의 터전을 꾸려 나갈 수 있는 환경을 만들어주는 게 가장 중요하다”며 “기업들이 자발적으로 여러 방안을 고심해 온 것으로 안다”고 했다. 정부도 간담회에서 지방에 투자하는 기업에 대한 세제 혜택 등 우대 방안을 마련해 소개할 것으로 전해졌다.)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik delivered a message targeting the youth at the senior secretary meeting on the same day, stating, "Excess tax revenue expected from the semiconductor boom should be intensively invested in projects for future generations." He added, "We must also boldly invest in discovering new growth engines to expand quality jobs." (강훈식 대통령 비서실장은 이날 수석보좌관회의에서 “반도체 호황으로 예상되는 초과 세수를 미래 세대를 위한 사업에 집중적으로 투자해야 한다”며 청년층을 향한 메시지를 냈다. 강 실장은 “양질의 일자리가 확대될 수 있도록 신성장 동력 발굴에도 과감히 투자해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Foreign Ministry: "North Korean Prisoners in Ukraine Expedited for Transfer to South Korea" (외교부 “우크라 北 포로, 한국행 신속 추진”)
item.description:
Foreign Ministry: "North Korean Prisoners in Ukraine Expedited for Transfer to South Korea" (외교부 “우크라 北 포로, 한국행 신속 추진”)

Regarding two North Korean soldiers captured by Ukraine while deployed to Russia, a senior Foreign Ministry official said on the 22nd, "We are moving to facilitate their transfer to South Korea as quickly as possible, in accordance with the free will of our citizens." In this regard, the ministry announced that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha will soon visit South Korea for talks with Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul on the 30th. (러시아 파병 중 우크라이나에 생포된 북한군 포로 2명과 관련해 외교부 고위 당국자가 22일 “가급적 신속하게 우리 국민의 자유의사에 따라 한국행을 추진하려고 하고 있다”고 말했다. 이와 관련, 외교부는 안드리 시비하 우크라이나 외교장관이 곧 방한해 오는 30일 조현 외교장관과 회담을 개최할 예정이라고 이날 밝혔다.)

The two North Korean prisoners, identified as Ri and Baek, who were captured by Ukrainian forces in January last year while deployed to Russia's western Kursk front, have repeatedly expressed their intent to defect to South Korea. The government has set a policy to facilitate their transfer to South Korea based on their wishes and has been in ongoing consultations with the Ukrainian side. (러시아 서부 쿠르스크 전선에 파병됐다가 지난해 1월 우크라이나군에 생포된 북한군 포로 리모씨와 백모씨는 여러 차례 한국으로 귀순할 의사를 밝혀 왔다. 정부는 본인들 의사에 따라 한국행을 추진한다는 방침을 세워 우크라이나 측과 관련 협의를 지속해 왔다.)

A senior Foreign Ministry official stated at a press briefing on the 22nd, "We have already reached a basic agreement with the Ukrainian side," adding, "The principle remains unchanged." The official further noted, "With the Ukrainian foreign minister's visit this time, I expect some progress." When asked whether the outcome of the South Korea-Ukraine foreign ministers' meeting could include an announcement on the North Korean prisoners' transfer to South Korea, the official replied, "It's hard for me to say," but added, "We are working toward that." (외교부 고위 당국자는 이날 기자 간담회에서 “우크라이나 측과 이미 기본적 합의는 다 이뤄져 있다”며 “그 원칙은 변함이 없다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이번에 (우크라이나) 외교장관이 방한하면 약간의 진전이 있지 않을까 기대하고 있다”고 했다. 한·우크라이나 외교장관 회담에서 ‘북한군 포로의 한국행과 같은 성과를 발표할 수 있느냐’는 질문에는 “제가 얘기하기 곤란하다”면서도 “그렇게 노력하고 있다”고 답했다.)

◇Transfer of North Korean Prisoners to South Korea in Final Stages; Possible Confirmation at 30th Talks (◇北포로 한국행 마무리 단계… 30일 회담서 확정 가능성)

With the senior Foreign Ministry official stating on the 22nd that a "basic agreement" has been reached with the Ukrainian government regarding the transfer of two North Korean prisoners to South Korea, there are expectations that their move could be realized soon. A diplomatic source said, "It is highly likely that the practical and legal procedures for the prisoners' transfer to South Korea are in their final stages." This suggests that the South Korea-Ukraine foreign ministers' meeting on the 30th could serve as a platform to finalize and coordinate the prisoners' defection to South Korea. If so, the transfer would occur about 17 months after the North Korean soldiers were captured in a special operation by Ukrainian forces. (외교부 고위 당국자가 22일 북한군 포로 2명의 한국행과 관련해 우크라이나 정부와 “기본적 합의”가 이뤄졌다고 하면서 이들의 한국행이 조만간 가시화될 것이란 관측이 나온다. 외교 소식통은 “북한군 포로들의 한국행을 위한 실무적·법적 절차가 사실상 마무리 단계일 가능성이 높다”고 했다. 30일 한·우크라이나 외교장관 회담이 북한군 포로들의 한국 귀순을 최종적으로 확정하고 조율하는 자리가 될 수 있다는 의미다. 이 경우 우크라이나군의 특수작전으로 북한군 포로들이 생포된 지 17개월여 만에 한국행이 성사될 전망이다.)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul, attending a full session of the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee in March, stated regarding the treatment of the two North Korean prisoners, "I met directly with the (Ukrainian) minister and received a guarantee that they would not be repatriated to North Korea or Russia." This commitment was reportedly secured during a meeting with Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha at the G7 foreign ministers' meeting in Canada in November last year. However, in exchange for allowing the prisoners' transfer to South Korea, Ukraine may be demanding more substantial and advanced support from the South Korean government behind the scenes, such as defense weapons aid or participation in post-war reconstruction. (조현 외교부 장관은 지난 3월 국회 외통위 전체회의에 출석해 북한군 포로 2명의 처우와 관련해 “제가 직접 (우크라이나) 장관과 면담해 (북·러로) 송환되지 않는다는 확약을 받았다”고 말한 바 있다. 지난해 11월 캐나다에서 열린 G7(주요 7국) 외교장관 회의에서 안드리 시비하 우크라이나 외교부 장관을 만나 약속을 받았다는 것이다. 다만 우크라이나가 북한군 포로의 한국행을 허용하는 대가로 물밑에서 우리 정부에 방어용 무기 지원이나 전후 재건 참여 등 더 실질적이고 진전된 지원을 요구할 수도 있다.)

The government's emphasis on "transfer to South Korea based on free will" and "commitment to barring repatriation to North Korea or Russia" is interpreted as a strategic move to ensure their safety while securing international legal legitimacy. The Third Geneva Convention on the treatment of prisoners of war stipulates the principle of repatriation to their home country. North Korea has also demanded the return of the two prisoners through Russia in negotiations with Ukraine over prisoner exchanges. (정부가 북한군 포로의 “자유의사에 따른 한국행”과 “북·러 송환 불허 확약”을 강조한 것은 이들의 안전 보장과 함께 국제법적 명분을 확보하기 위한 포석으로 해석된다. 포로의 처우에 대한 제네바 제3협약은 전쟁포로에 대한 ‘본국 송환의 원칙’을 규정하고 있다. 북한도 러시아를 통해 우크라이나와의 포로 교환 협상에서 북한군 포로 2명의 송환을 요구해 왔다.)

However, the North Korean prisoners expressed their wish to defect to South Korea in interviews with this newspaper in February last year. International law includes the principle of "non-refoulement," which prohibits repatriating someone to a place where their life or physical freedom may be violated against their will. It is understood that South Korea and Ukraine agree on the need to uphold this principle. (하지만 북한군 포로들은 지난해 2월 본지 인터뷰 등에서 한국으로의 귀순 의사를 밝혀 왔다. 국제법에는 당사자의 의사에 반해 생명이나 신체의 자유를 침해받을 수 있는 곳으로 송환해서는 안 된다는 ‘강제 송환 금지’ 원칙이 있으며, 한국과 우크라이나는 이 원칙을 준수해야 한다는 데 공감하고 있는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Meanwhile, Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul told a press briefing on the 22nd that the government has "proactively prepared" to enable South Korean companies to participate in post-war reconstruction projects in the Middle East following a potential U.S.-Iran agreement. This includes the establishment of a "Korea-Middle East Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Team" within the ministry to support South Korean businesses' recovery efforts and economic cooperation in the region. However, the ministry clarified that this team was not specifically created with a reconstruction fund discussed in the ongoing peace talks in mind. A senior Foreign Ministry official said, "It was primarily set up to prioritize cooperation with the six Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries," adding, "No formal request for participation in a reconstruction fund has been received yet." (한편, 조현 외교부 장관은 22일 기자 간담회를 열어 정부가 미국·이란의 종전 합의 이후 한국 기업이 중동 지역 재건 사업에 참여할 수 있도록 “선제적으로 대비해왔다”고 밝혔다. 우리 기업의 대중동 피해 복구 참여와 경제협력을 위해 외교부 내 ‘한·중동 포괄적 경제협력팀’을 설치했다는 것이다. 다만 외교부는 이 경제협력팀이 종전 협상에서 논의 중인 재건기금 참여를 염두에 두고 구성된 것은 아니라고 했다. 외교부 고위 당국자는 “걸프협력회의(GCC) 6개국 협력을 우선으로 구성한 것”이라며 “재건기금은 아직 정식으로 참여 요청이 들어온 것이 없다”고 했다.)

Regarding South Korea-U.S. nuclear cooperation, including the construction of a nuclear-powered submarine, uranium enrichment, and securing rights for spent nuclear fuel reprocessing, a senior Foreign Ministry official stated on the 22nd, "We expect to reach an agreement within this year." The official said, "There could be an amendment to the nuclear cooperation agreement, or we could add an appendix using existing provisions. There are various options," adding, "Our clear goal is to reach a swift agreement." (한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함(원잠) 건조와 우라늄 농축, 사용후핵연료 재처리 권한 확보 등을 포함한 한미 간 원자력 협력과 관련해 외교부 고위 당국자는 이날 “연내에 타결될 수 있을 것으로 기대한다”고 밝혔다. 이 당국자는 “(한국이 농축·재처리 권한을 가지려면) 원자력 협력 협정의 개정이 있을 수 있고 거기에 기존에 있는 것을 활용해서 부록을 붙이는 방안도 있고 여러 가지가 있다”며 “신속하게 합의를 끌어내고자 하는 게 분명히 목표”라고 했다.)

The senior official noted, "On the Coupang issue, a certain degree of consensus has been reached between the South Korean and U.S. authorities," and "We will manage it well to prevent any excessive amplification or reproduction of the company's violation of local laws." Regarding the U.S. restriction on sharing North Korea-related intelligence after Unification Minister Kim Young-ho identified 'Kusong in North Pyongan Province' as the location of a North Korean uranium enrichment facility in March, the senior official said, "Both the U.S. and we are likely looking for a way out of this." (이 고위 당국자는 “쿠팡 문제는 한미 정부 당국 간에는 어느 정도 의견 일치가 이뤄졌다”면서 “기업의 실정법 위반 문제가 과도하게 확대, 재생산되지 않도록 잘 관리해 나갈 것”이라고 했다. 정동영 통일부 장관이 지난 3월 북한의 우라늄 농축 시설 소재지로 ‘평북 구성’을 지목한 후 미국이 대북 정보 공유를 제한한 데 대해, 외교부 고위 당국자는 “미국 측도 그렇고 우리도 그렇고 여기에 대한 출구를 찾지 않겠는가”라고 했다.)
